description.en: An example extension built only on cmux-extension-sdk: the pull requests you touched lately, open and merged, newest first, in a sidebar section.

scopes.integration:github:read: Read your pull requests through your connected GitHub account, without seeing its token.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a browser tab when you click it.

optionalScopes.net:api.github.com: Without a connected account, read the public pull requests of the GitHub login in this extension's settings.
